features.title: Rounded glass loading animation
features.user_visible_behavior: Silent rounded liquid-glass labyla loader over six cyan/deep-teal lines; plays complete cycles until resources are ready, then exits after all lines leave.
acceptance_criteria: Apply the inspected Bencho dark preset optical equations to glyph contours: 1.1x magnification, bend 1, fringe 0.4, 41.4px bevel, inner rim lighting and soft shadow.
Keep the original pink/purple interactive background intact but unmounted.
Fit desktop/mobile screens without cropping the wordmark or adding scrollbars.
Pass Docker TypeScript/build and harness checks; inspect visual fidelity against the reference.
Individual lines brake to rest near the centre at staggered times, hold, and accelerate away with a mirrored velocity curve.
Six stripes move from bottom-left to top-right, have softly blurred lateral edges on both sides, and leave the viewport before resetting without an interior fade mask.
Every stripe has the same crisp middle and blurred ends along its length, independent of its perpendicular offset.
Resting stripe spacing is tighter (0.95 units); the speed curve has a steeper parabolic rise with a gentle zero-speed start.
Use a horizontal baseline at 640 px and above; stack the six upright letters below 640 px, without clipping or overflow.
Restore six stripes, 0.95 pitch, 0.475 width and 0.035-cycle stagger; retain motion stages, direction and focus.
Background lines fade from bright cyan to deep blue-green like the latest attached reference; glyph outer corners and inner joins are rounded.
Refraction remains continuous across thin stroke centres; contour and refracted-line edges are antialiased at desktop/mobile sizes.
Use silent full-cycle loading behavior; no sound controls or audio synthesis remain.

features.title: Illuminated panel assembly and liquid-glass menu morph
features.user_visible_behavior: After lit panel assembly, glass letters flow into a loose mass without intermediate braking. Desktop order is b,y,first a,second l,first l,final a; mobile order is top-to-bottom. The menu forms early and the last three letters flow directly into it.
acceptance_criteria: Remove all audio functionality and controls.
Wait for window load, fonts and the background first frame.
Always finish at least one full cycle; repeat if not ready, then wait for the next full boundary.
All six delayed lines leave before assembly; no first line respawns in the tail.
Panels actually translate from upper-left with staggered cubic braking.
The resting background is black and reveals the loader palette on pointer hover.
Desktop/mobile complete the sequence without overflow; intro cleanup leaves one canvas.
Keep text visible above panels throughout their assembly.
Illuminate every panel during arrival, independent of hover.
Pointer motion leaves advected trails that fade after movement stops; flutes move autonomously without a cursor.

After the last panel arrives, melt letters in order b, y, first a, second l, first l, final a on wide screens and 1–6 top-to-bottom in vertical mode; use gentle start, quadratic speed growth and smooth braking before spreading into the menu.
Preserve transparent background-panel refraction throughout; cyan glow is weak and diffuse, with no opaque colour fill or bright contour.
The fixed horizontal menu has slight frost and no items or links. Initial letters remain vertical below 640px.
Enable pointer trails and flute drift when the morph ends; keep the glass menu visible and refracting the live background.

The shared blot begins with the first letter in the active layout order (b horizontally, top l vertically); subsequent letters start later and accelerate until merging. The growing combined mass retains asymmetric lobes and indentations during flight.
The mass widens toward the entire menu throughout travel, without first collecting at a central point and revealing the menu sideways.
The mass has no intermediate waits or speed dips; braking occurs only at final arrival. Followers accelerate until absorption.
Menu formation overlaps letter travel: the final three letters merge directly into the formed menu.
Start letters exactly 100ms apart. Near menu contact each compact mass spreads slightly sideways and flattens, without extending beyond the menu width.
